question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of electricity transmission and distribution lines in Germany, with voltage level, operator and status?

answer.summary: ATKIS provides open vectors for high-voltage overhead lines. BNetzA’s project layers cover transmission expansion sections with voltage, operator and status. JAO’s Core static grid model gives circuit voltage and operator without geometry. OpenStreetMap adds some distribution routes and cables, with variable completeness. VDE FNN serves generalised 380 and 220 kV routes. No complete open distribution dataset was verified.
main_caveats: The ATKIS sources checked focus on overhead lines, with a documented capture threshold of 110 kV. Voltage, operator and status were unavailable in the samples. These sources do not provide a distribution cable inventory.
BNetzA layers cover only BBPlG/EnLAG expansion sections; 46 of 157 BBPlG features are 'Luftlinie' or 'Korridorverlauf', not routes.
VDE FNN geometry is generalised (about one vertex per 4.4 km), has no operator field and states no licence.
JAO/TSO static grid models list circuits by substation pair with TSO and kV but no geometry; the bundled HTML map draws straight lines.
TenneT's WMS returns images only; its 2018 terms require written permission to store, digitise or republish the data.
answer.confidence_reason: All listed sources opened and queried (national OSM, DLM250, three Länder, JAO, BNetzA); DSO publication only sampled (WEMAG NAP, Bayernwerk blocked) and GDI-DE catalogue unreachable.

attributes.note: Official vectors: ATKIS overhead lines ≥110 kV and BNetzA expansion sections; OSM adds cables and MV/LV lines; TenneT WMS is image-only.
attributes.gap_note: No official open routes of underground cables or MV/LV lines: checked BNetzA, BKG/Länder ATKIS, VNBdigital NAPs, four TSO sites, TenneT/Bayernwerk WMS, GovData (Düsseldorf points to Planauskunft).

attributes.note: With geometry: BNetzA projects, VDE 380/220 kV and OSM (98% of line ways). JAO gives kV per TSO circuit without geometry; ATKIS has none.
attributes.gap_note: No official voltage on 110 kV or MV/LV routes: ATKIS SPG empty in NRW (-9998), absent in HE, BY and DLM250; no other official layer found.

attributes.note: BNetzA Vorhabenträger (projects), JAO TSO per circuit (no geometry), TenneT WMS owner by click, OSM operator on 59% of line ways.
attributes.gap_note: No open per-line operator for the 110 kV and MV/LV networks; ATKIS and VDE lack the field; DSO plans only via Leitungsauskunft portals after registration.

attributes.note: BNetzA per-section lifecycle (in Betrieb … vor/im Planfeststellungsverfahren); VDE operating vs planning/construction; OSM construction tags.
attributes.gap_note: No official lifecycle field for the existing grid (ATKIS maps existing lines only); DSO planned measures only in NAP spreadsheets without geometry and UVP-Verbund notices.

sources.name: Netzausbau – Kartenansicht: feature layers Vorhaben_BBPlG and Vorhaben_EnLAG (Monitoring_gdb)

sources.coverage_note: 183 project sections nationwide; existing grid and distribution excluded.
caveats: Licence not stated on the map page.

coverage.geographic: Germany; transmission expansion projects of the Bundesbedarfsplangesetz (BBPlG, 157 section features) and EnLAG (26 section features); existing grid outside these projects is not included.

unit.value: Voltage as text with kV in field Spannung (e.g. '380 kV', '525 kV', '320 bis 525 kV', 'unbekannt'); SHAPE__Length in Web Mercator metres, not ground metres.

inclusion_rule.value: Sections of projects listed in BBPlG or EnLAG (field Grundlage 'BBPlG', 'BBPlG, PCI' or 'EnLAG'); one feature per project section and status.

attempts.note: Map page states no update rhythm.
DANA page says BMWE and BNetzA report 'regelmäßig' from DANA data; no frequency for the map layer.

exclusions.value: Existing grid outside BBPlG/EnLAG projects; distribution (110 kV and below); 'Luftlinie' (33) and 'Korridorverlauf' (13) features are not routes.

key_fields.meaning: Lifecycle state of the section (e.g. 'Abschnitt in Betrieb', 'Abschnitt genehmigt oder im Bau', 'Abschnitt vor/im Planfeststellungsverfahren').
Overhead line, underground or submarine cable; AC or DC.

how_to_use.example_result: {'Vorhaben': 'Punkt Metternich – Niederstedem', 'Vorhabennu': 'BBPlG 15', 'Vorhabenst': 'Abschnitt genehmigt oder im Bau', 'Typ': 'Trassenverlauf', 'Spannung': '380 kV', 'Vorhabentr': 'Amprion', 'Ausführung': 'Freileitung'} (returnCountOnly: 41)
steps: Query layer 0 (BBPlG, 157 features) and layer 1 (EnLAG, 26 features) with where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=json (maxRecordCount 2000, one page suffices).
Keep Typ='Trassenverlauf' for actual routes; treat 'Korridorverlauf' and 'Luftlinie' as indicative only.
Use Vorhabenst for lifecycle and Vorhabentr for the operator; split multi-operator values such as '50Hertz, TenneT'.
Offshore grid connections are in the separate layer Anbindungsleitungen/FeatureServer/0 (5 features, field Name only).
reading_traps: 33 BBPlG features are Typ 'Luftlinie' and 13 'Korridorverlauf': straight lines or corridors, not routes.
Spannung is 'unbekannt' in 23 BBPlG features and null in 1; one feature reads '320 bis 525 kV'.
SHAPE__Length is in Web Mercator units (about 1.6× ground length at 52° N).
Status 'Abschnitt fertiggestellt' (8+4) differs from 'Abschnitt in Betrieb' (28+17); both are completed states.
Vorhabentr can list two TSOs for a shared section (e.g. '50Hertz, TenneT' 18 features).

evidence.claim: The netzausbau.de map loads these ArcGIS feature layers.
Underlying monitoring database DANA is not public.
evidence.quote: Die Webanwendung ist für die Übertragungsnetzbetreiber, die Genehmigungsbehörden, das Bundeswirtschaftsministerium sowie die Bundesnetzagentur zugänglich.

coverage.geographic: Germany, all voltage levels mapped by volunteers; completeness not guaranteed, cables underrepresented.

unit.value: voltage in volts without unit, several circuits separated by ';' (e.g. 380000;110000).
unit.quote: voltage=*: Enter volts with no unit or digit grouping

inclusion_rule.value: Whatever contributors map: power=line (overhead transmission/HV), power=minor_line (MV/LV overhead), power=cable (underground/submarine).

attempts.note: German wiki page documents tagging but states no inclusion threshold.

reference_date.value: Live database; Overpass timestamp_osm_base 2026-11-27T08:04:02Z for the national counts.

attempts.note: timestamp_osm_base minutes behind query time (08:04Z at 08:0xZ).
Wiki marks planned lines 'Weg noch nicht definiert' and is flagged out of date; no statement of exclusions.

key_fields.meaning: Volts; ';' separates circuits of different voltage.
Operator name; spelling varies (e.g. 'TenneT', 'TenneT TSO GmbH').
Number of circuits, conductor sets, bundle type.
Line name and line number (e.g. 'Ltg 449 Mecklar - Vieselbach').

how_to_use.example_request: POST data=[out:json][timeout:600];area["ISO3166-1"="DE"][admin_level=2]->.de;way["power"="line"](area.de)->.l;.l out count;way.l["voltage"]->.v;.v out count;way.l["operator"]->.o;.o out count;way["power"="cable"](area.de);out count;way["power"~"construction"]["construction"~"line|cable"](area.de);out count;way["construction:power"~"line|cable"](area.de);out count; to https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter
how_to_use.example_result: power=line 51354 ways; with voltage 50387; with operator 30254; power=cable 6945; power=construction line|cable 420; construction:power line|cable 570
steps: Query Germany by area (ISO3166-1=DE) or per Land (ISO3166-2=DE-TH etc.); national queries take 2+ minutes and can return 504, so split by Land.
Use out geom (or out body + recurse) to get coordinates; e.g. way(29023494);out tags geom; returned 'Ltg 449 Mecklar - Vieselbach', operator '50Hertz Transmission', voltage 380000.
Split voltage on ';' and convert volts to kV; normalise operator spellings.
Union power=line, power=minor_line and power=cable for a full network; add construction tags for status.
reading_traps: overpass-api.de answered HTTP 406 to plain curl requests; maps.mail.ru instance answered (twice 504 under load).
41% of German power=line ways lack operator (30254 of 51354 tagged); Thüringen sample 86% (1369/1588).
Operator values vary per TSO (wiki lists 'TenneT', 'TenneT TSO', 'TenneT TSO GmbH', 'TenneT_TSO').
No lifecycle tag for 'in operation'; only construction/proposed tagging, used on 420 + 570 ways.
UFZ's 2016 OSM-derived shapefile (CC BY-NC-SA, request form) is an older snapshot of the same data.

problems: overpass-api.de returns HTTP 406 to requests without browser headers; other public instance used.

evidence.claim: Lines are tagged with operator and voltage.
evidence.quote: Die Leitung ist neben power=line mit operator=*, voltage=*, wires=* versehen.
The data included in this document is from www.openstreetmap.org. The data is made available under ODbL.

if_unstructured.summary: Routes of planned or approved 110 kV–525 kV lines and DSO plans appear in approval documents (Lagepläne 1:2000, Masttabellen) and §14d network plans; these give operator, voltage and status.
recipe: Take BNetzA sections with Vorhabenst 'vor/im Planfeststellungsverfahren' or 'genehmigt oder im Bau' and open the matching section page on netzausbau.de.

Download the decision folder 'Ordner 2 | Technische Pläne' (Masttabellen: operator, line number, voltage, pylon numbers and spans) and 'Ordner 3 | Lagepläne' (61 PDF sheets for Ultranet C1); large ZIPs can be listed by HTTP Range.
Read Masttabellen with pdftotext -layout; rows are split over two lines (span length on the following line).
For 110 kV DSO projects search UVP-Verbund by '110-kV' and Land; record Vorhabenträger, length and procedure stage.
For DSO planned measures read the VNBdigital 'Maßnahmen' XLSX (sheet Maßnahmenplan, header row 3) for status and overhead/cable; no coordinates.
if_unstructured.location_method: Lagepläne are 1:2000 PDF sheets on the cadastral base (e.g. 'Katasteramt : Stadt Neuss') showing pylons and line axis; georeference against ALKIS/DOP or match to ATKIS AX_Leitung; Masttabellen carry no coordinates.

where_published.name: netzausbau.de – BNetzA project pages (NABEG Planfeststellung)
where_published.what: Applications, §21 documents and Planfeststellungsbeschlüsse for federal transmission projects, per section, with ZIP folders of technical plans and Lagepläne.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Choose project in 'Alle Vorhaben', then the section (e.g. 'Abschnitt C1') and the step 'Planfeststellungsbeschluss'; no full-text search across documents.

where_published.name: VNBdigital – Netzausbaupläne of DSOs (§ 14d/14e EnWG)
where_published.what: Per DSO: Netzausbauplan PDF with HV/MV network maps, plus 'Netzausbauplan_kompakt' and 'Maßnahmen' XLSX (measures with overhead/cable, km, Projektstatus, Genehmigungsstand).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: SPA: search operator, open its page (e.g. /vnb/719); documents also via GraphQL gateway/graphql query vnb_gridExpansionDocumentsExternal(vnbId).

where_published.name: UVP-Verbund – environmental assessment portal of Bund and Länder
where_published.what: Approval and screening notices for 110 kV and other line projects decided by Länder authorities (category 'Leitungsanlagen und vergleichbare Anlagen').
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Freitextsuche (e.g. '110-kV-Freileitung' → 39 hits), filter by Land and procedure type; documents link to authority sites or cloud folders.
